obligations.source_text: Independently invent and visibly test a complex mythic photograph in which three adult fate-workers allocate one adult recipient's lifespan through one continuous thread, while using the supplied portrait only as visible facial and hair appearance guidance for the central worker.

bindings.figures_phrase: three distinct fate figures occupy separate readable work roles around one shared mortal allocation table
bindings.spin_phrase: the first figure visibly spins or draws the beginning of the thread from a loaded wooden spindle into a bright origin coil
bindings.measure_phrase: the second figure visibly measures an allotted section of that same thread against a graduated bronze rule with marked endpoints
bindings.cut_phrase: the third figure visibly cuts the endpoint of that same thread with open iron shears at the marked terminal point
bindings.thread_phrase: one continuous mortal life thread physically connects the spin measure and cut roles from origin across the rule to the recipient's hourglass token
